name: feed-change-watcher
title: RSS Feed Monitor: New Items Only
description: Give it a list of RSS or Atom feeds. Each run returns only the items that were not returned in an earlier run, one row per item, plus a report with the item count per source. It remembers what it already sent, so the second run is short.

source-checked.eventDescription: One feed fetched, parsed and compared against the items already returned for it. Charged once per feed read; a feed that could not be fetched is not charged.

change-report.eventDescription: Charged once at the end of a run that found at least one new item, for the report listing new items per source, feeds read and feeds that failed. A run with nothing new does not pay this event.
